question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        e.visit_id,
        e.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
purchased_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
page_views AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 1
    GROUP BY product_id
),
added_to_cart AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cart_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 2
    GROUP BY product_id
),
left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT pe.product_id, COUNT(*) AS left_count
    FROM product_events pe
    LEFT JOIN purchased_visits pv ON pe.visit_id = pv.visit_id
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2 AND pv.visit_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY pe.product_id
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT pcv.product_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT pe.product_id, pe.visit_id
        FROM product_events pe
        WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    ) pcv
    JOIN purchased_visits pv ON pcv.visit_id = pv.visit_id
    GROUP BY pcv.product_id
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(pv.product_id, atc.product_id, lic.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(pv.view_count, 0) AS page_views,
    COALESCE(atc.cart_count, 0) AS added_to_cart,
    COALESCE(lic.left_count, 0) AS left_in_cart,
    COALESCE(p.purchase_count, 0) AS purchases
FROM page_views pv
FULL OUTER JOIN added_to_cart atc ON pv.product_id = atc.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN left_in_cart lic ON atc.product_id = lic.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN purchases p ON lic.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY product_id

    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 2
    GROUP BY product_id
),

    GROUP BY pe.product_id
),

)

FROM page_views pv

FULL OUTER JOIN left_in_cart lic ON atc.product_id = lic.product_id

ORDER BY product_id"}
